copias_restauracion_propuesta_invalida: The proposal is incomplete or contains unsupported data.
copias_restauracion_propuesta_alterada: The proposal has changed. Prepare a new proposal and review it again.
copias_restauracion_caducada: The proposal has expired. Prepare a new proposal.
copias_restauracion_misma_persona: Another person must perform the review.
copias_restauracion_configuracion_invali: Dual control is required for operations. It may only be explicitly disabled in the offline example.
copias_restauracion_autoridad_no_vigente: A current permission for this action has not been established.
copias_restauracion_dependencia_ausente: A provider required to check the operation is missing.
copias_restauracion_compatibilidad_bloqu: The backup set is incompatible or cannot be checked.
copias_restauracion_preimagen_cambiada: The destination, backup set or policy has changed. Prepare a new proposal.
copias_restauracion_copia_previa_ausente: A complete, verified backup of the current state under the same writer exclusion is missing.
copias_restauracion_ventana_no_vigente: The restoration window is not current.
copias_restauracion_cas_conflicto: The reviewed version no longer matches the stored version.
copias_restauracion_registro_no_valido: The proposal register cannot be verified.
copias_restauracion_error_argumentos: Specify a private register directory and a supported action.
copias_restauracion_error_entrada: The input does not meet the required format.
copias_restauracion_declaracion_guardada: The offline declaration is stored. It does not establish identity, permission or restoration.
copias_restauracion_perdida_cambios: Restoration will replace the complete destination set. Changes made after the backup will be lost; review and reconcile them before continuing.
